project_type: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 SPA
test_framework: No test framework configured (no test files exist)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify the project compiles without errors. Run npm run lint to check for lint issues.
environment_constraints: Open internet available. No test runner configured - verification is build + lint only.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing module pattern: page component in src/pages/, components in src/components/<module>/, route in App.jsx, nav item in Sidebar.jsx, seed data in src/data/, storage helpers in src/lib/storage.js
key_patterns: Each module has: a page component (src/pages/X.jsx) with tab navigation, sub-components in src/components/x/, seed data function in src/data/seedX.js, localStorage get/save helpers in src/lib/storage.js, context state+updater in src/context/AppContext.jsx. Tabs use a TABS array with id/label/icon rendered as pill buttons. Lucide icons throughout. Purple brand color #5B2D8E.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - page-level route components; src/components/<module>/ - feature components; src/data/ - seed data factories; src/lib/ - utilities (storage.js); src/hooks/ - custom hooks; src/context/ - AppContext global state
